summary: Boundary County, ID: a 10-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab from the 1930s, listed as gone; no source gives a removal date or describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; the pages give no removal date and do not describe the site today

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in and gives no trail details

evidence.supports: elevation 6535 feet on Idaho Fire Lookouts
1930s date and 10-foot pole on Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Only two secondary pages describe this lookout, and they agree. Both give 1930s and a 10-foot pole, which is short for an L-4 tower; I did not check that against any register or photo. No event is recorded because the sources give only a decade and no removal date. Searches for Silver Mountain in Idaho return the Silver Mountain resort near Kellogg, which is unrelated and was not used. Idaho Fire Lookouts has a second post under the north-idaho-panhandle-region path with the same title; it added no facts. No FFLOS or NHLR register page for this site was in the local cache, and the record lists none.
